clarified_messages.content: Okay, I'm finally here—just got into the conference room.
Perfect. I’m still over at the lab. Can you check if the new samples made it to your place?
Let me see. Yeah, the box is right by the door. Want me to open it?
Yes, open it and send me a photo of what’s inside. The designer said the prototype’s supposed to be in there.
Alright, there’s one wrapped package, and a folder with some paperwork. I’ll snap a picture.
Can you forward that folder to him when you get a chance?
Sure, but is he at your location or the client’s?
He’s with me—he stepped out for a quick call, but he should be back in five.
Okay, I’ll bring it over when I head there later.
Great. By the way, can you double-check the schedule for the QA review? Is it still at noon or did it shift?
It moved to 12:30, so we have a bit more time.
Perfect. Then after that, let’s meet at the café next door for the wrap-up with our coordinator.
Got it. That’s the one on 45th, right?
Yeah, the Green Bean Café. She’ll be there at one.
Confirmed. I’ll head there after the review. Can you ask her to bring the signed release forms?
I’ll text her now. Oh, did you talk to the vendor about the revised specs?
Not yet. Did he send them to your email or mine?
Mine. I’ll forward it, but I’m not sure if all the changes are included.
Thanks. If there’s anything missing, let me know—I'll call him before noon.
Will do. By the way, did you see the message from her about the launch checklist?
I did, but I haven’t looked at the attachment yet. Is it in the drive?
It’s in the shared folder named 'Nimbus_Final'. The checklist doc should be updated as of this morning.
Alright, I’ll open it now. Anything from the team at the downtown office?
They sent a note about the server migration. The IT lead said it starts at three, not two.
Okay, I’ll update the timeline. Has the client responded about the demo link?
He replied this morning—he wants it at 10 AM tomorrow instead of this afternoon.
That’s doable. I’ll ask the dev to reschedule.
Let me know when you’ve talked to him. He had a security concern.
Will do. I’ll pass along my notes.
Also, can you send the NDA to her before the end of the day?
Of course. I’ll attach it when I send the feedback doc.
Thanks. Oh, are the testers in your area ready for the dry run?
I think so. The coordinator from QA said they’d be here by eleven.
Good. If you need anything, let me know.
Actually, can you ask him about the final build status?
Sure, I’ll talk to him when I see him.
The weather is wild over here—raining again.
Same here, can barely see outside. At least the internet’s stable!
Let’s hope there are no outages during the launch.
Agreed. Okay, I’m heading to the QA room now.
Remember to give the prototype to her when you see her there.
Yep. She’s usually at the table by the windows.
After you meet her, call me so I can update the timeline.
Will do. By the way, did you change the passwords for the cloud storage?
I did, but I’ll send you the new ones securely, just in case.
Smart. Okay, heading out. See you at the café later.
See you there. Don’t forget the package!
Got it. I’m bringing it.
Okay, one last thing—client’s assistant asked for a summary after the launch. Can you prep that, or should I?
I’ll handle it. Let’s touch base tonight if anything else pops up.
